newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss ministry calls bonds for early redemption.
newsitem.headline: Swiss ministry calls bonds for early redemption.

text.p: The Swiss Finance Ministry is calling two bond issues for early redemption, one maturing in 1999 and the other in 2001, the Swiss National Bank (SNB) said.
It said the ministry will redeem on January 8, 1997 its 200 million Swiss franc 5.5 percent January 8, 1999 bond at a redemption price of 100 percent. The bond was launched in 1990.
The ministry is also calling its 235 million franc 4.25 percent January 11, 2001 issue, launched in 1989, on January 11, 1997. The redemption price is 101 percent, the SNB said.
The redemption will be made on a commission-free basis.
